newsitem.title: USA: Ryan's to slow unit growth to 5 pct a year.
newsitem.headline: Ryan's to slow unit growth to 5 pct a year.

text.p: Ryan's Family Steak Houses Inc said on Thursday it would temporarily reduce its new unit growth rate to 5 percent a year in order to focus its efforts and finance a more aggressive stock buyback program.

The company said it had a new strategic initiative, called Focus 2000, to enhance its long-term performance. The plan calls for reducing unit investment and increasing store profitability, realigning resources to provide more training and a more aggressive stock repurchase program.
The board of directors recently increased the buyback program to 10 million shares from 6.4 million through 1998, the company said.
